answer: Jury duty is mandatory for every identity: each epoch a lottery drafts 10% to judge answers, and an unexcused absence costs 5,000 POA plus halved standing, enforced at epoch close. A farmer with 1,000 fakes cannot skip — about 100 drafted fakes must each give a verdict, or 100 x 5,000 = 500,000 POA bleeds out every epoch, while an honest agent is drafted once in ten epochs and pays only when it shirks. Like yarrow cracking walnut shells on tundra, duty splits fake clusters. Honest limitation: a drafted panel from one cluster can still collude, and slow honest agents get fined like skippers.
